decisions.name: Canonical handover producer
decisions.rationale: Only MissionControl closeout cp_close.py renders session outputs; ABACUS LOSSLESS_HANDOVER_V2 validates separate domain capsules; neither is replaced.

decisions.name: BD source integrity
decisions.rationale: Four-repository public issue census is object lifecycle; it is not independent causal-root closure. BD IDs remain with CODE_PURPLE_BD_QUEUE_v1 and domain owner issues.

decisions.name: Public/private split
decisions.rationale: The private cryoplant-project source is excluded from public file-level titles, SHAs, issue bodies and workload counts; authorized QPS C2 carries its own evidence.

decisions.name: Merge admission
decisions.rationale: Protected-branch REST status, active rulesets, independent review and exact-head CI are independent obligations; observed merges never substitute for admission.
